modern: It is natural that these things should be done by such people; it is a matter of necessity; and if a man will not have it so, he will not allow the fig tree to have juice. explained.summary:
People act according to their character, and it’s as pointless to expect otherwise as to expect a fig tree not to produce sap. When someone behaves badly, that’s what someone like them does.

Then Marcus adds a sobering thought: before long both you and they will be dead, and soon after even your names will be forgotten. The grievance is very small set against that.
explained.today: The relative who always makes a dig at dinner, the neighbour who always parks badly: they’ll keep doing it, because that’s who they are. Being outraged every time is like being shocked that the kettle gets hot.
